## gcode_macro BEEP

Switch the beeper pin on for 10 milliseconds, then off.

| Source line | Code | Plain explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [1](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L1) | <code>[gcode_macro BEEP]</code> | Declare this callable macro. |
| [2](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L2) | <code>gcode:</code> | Begin the command template. The following indented lines belong to it. |
| [3](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L3) | <code>SET_PIN PIN=beeper VALUE=1</code> | Set the named output pin to VALUE; this is used for the beeper, not the main LED object. |
| [4](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L4) | <code>G4 P10</code> | Wait for <code>P10</code> (P is milliseconds; 1000 ms = 1 second). |
| [5](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L5) | <code>SET_PIN PIN=beeper VALUE=0</code> | Set the named output pin to VALUE; this is used for the beeper, not the main LED object. |

<a id="gcode_macro-_lcd_status_preheating"></a>

## gcode_macro _LCD_STATUS_PREHEATING

Set all three LCD NeoPixels to orange immediately without synchronizing to queued toolhead motion.

| Source line | Code | Plain explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [7](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L7) | <code>[gcode_macro _LCD_STATUS_PREHEATING]</code> | Declare this callable macro. |
| [8](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L8) | <code>description: Set the LCD illumination orange for print preparation</code> | Set the help text: <code>Set the LCD illumination orange for print preparation</code>. |
| [9](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L9) | <code>gcode:</code> | Begin the command template. The following indented lines belong to it. |
| [10](../../../config/options/lcd/macros.cfg#L10) | <code>SET_LED LED=Screen_Colour RED=1 GREEN=0.5 BLUE=0 SYNC=0</code> | Set the named LED channel brightness on a 0..1 scale. WHITE selects the white channel. SYNC=0 applies without synchronizing to queued motion; otherwise synchronization is enabled by default. |

## gcode_macro _LCD_STATUS_PAUSED

Set all three LCD NeoPixels to yellow immediately without synchronizing to queued toolhead motion. Mainsail invokes this for ordinary pauses, runout pauses and M600.
